description: This file is a shell script containing a comprehensive test suite for verifying the correctness of cache-tree updates within a Git repository. It defines multiple functions to generate, compare, and verify cache-tree state, and runs a series of tests involving Git commands such as add, commit, reset, checkout, merge, and others to ensure cache-tree integrity across various operations.

methods.name: cmp_cache_tree
methods.description: Compares the current cache-tree output against an expected file after filtering out references.

methods.name: generate_expected_cache_tree
methods.description: Recursively generates the expected cache-tree representation for a given path and subdirectory.

methods.name: test_cache_tree
methods.description: Verifies that the current cache-tree matches the expected state, optionally comparing with a provided status file.

methods.name: test_invalid_cache_tree
methods.description: Checks that the cache-tree correctly reports an invalid state after modifications.

methods.name: test_no_cache_tree
methods.description: Verifies that the cache-tree is empty.
